decisions: Native toast 18px corners,16px inset,12px gap and double 10% black shadow offsets are retained.382px native width is a preferred maximum rather than a fixed sample box; viewport margin 16px bounds narrow screens. The pinned source collapsed/expanded stack is translated into readable component rules: measured height/offset/index,12px peek,0.1 index scale step, native pointer swipe movement and source 500ms transform/opacity,150ms height and 250ms content opacity. Source limited objects stay inert/transparent, source behind content is hidden until expanded, and close/removal remain distinct after actual CSS transition. Reduced motion chooses 0.01ms finite transition rather than waiting on invisible 500ms motion. Native natural-height measurement temporarily sets Root height auto, preserving longer text/actions without fixed 72px clipping. Source Close is aria-hidden while the stack is collapsed and Close itself lacks focus; actual F6 viewport focus expands the stack and exposes its name. The canonical default is the expanded low-priority state; collapsed fixtures retain that source distinction. Static 118px heights/offsets illustrate the measured default recipe at382px width; actual source measurement grows with wrapping. Source Toaster private content/text wrapper and type Icon are mapped explicitly; Button source styles apply to Action/Close, with meaningful names and no fabricated onOpenChange. Default low-priority Toast Root is genuinely nonmodal role dialog/aria-modal=false, with labelled/described title and polite viewport; higher urgency remains separately documented source behavior. Document theme/dir is caller context for source private portal; actions and timeout 0 persistent task feedback retain actual manager semantics. No page/node coordinate or arbitrary per-notification CSS identity is used.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
